metadata.title: Minimalist Autumnal Album Layout
useCases: Classical or Easy Listening Album Art

retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist layout featuring a small, vertically-oriented framed photograph centered within a vast field of off-white negative space, topped with stacked, stylized serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, centered composition on a cream/off-white background. The top third contains two distinct levels of typography: a thin, elegant serif and a bolder, decorative Art Nouveau-inspired serif. The center features a small, rectangular photograph of an autumnal landscape with golden light, acting as the primary visual anchor.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of text elements above a central image
Extreme ratio of negative space to subject matter
Warm color harmony between the photo and the cream background
Contrast between thin hairline serifs and bold decorative glyphs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small vertical rectangle (approx 25% of height) centered in the middle of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photograph with high-saturation golden and brown tones.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the primary title to the artist name, then resting on the central image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 75% of the canvas is empty off-white space.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and burnt orange within the photograph
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key, low-saturation background contrasting with a high-saturation, warm-toned central focal point.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and black

letterConstructionRules: Top line: extreme stroke contrast with hairline serifs
Bottom line: thick, blocky stems with internal decorative cutouts or 'inline' effects
Tight letter spacing (kerning) with occasional ligatures or overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: O characters in the decorative line feature vertical split or internal oval details
H and M characters have elongated, sharp serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a delicate, airy serif and a heavy, geometric decorative serif.
graphicDevices: Thin black border around the photograph

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, elegant serif look of the top line.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Desdemona or Art Nouveau display fonts
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the decorative, blocky, and stylized nature of the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid cream-colored square canvas. In the center, place a small vertical rectangular photograph of a sun-drenched autumn forest with orange leaves and long shadows. The photo should have a very thin black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center-align two levels of black text at the top. The first level should be a thin, high-contrast serif. The second level should be a bold, decorative Art Nouveau serif with tight spacing, stacked in two lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm off-white?
Is the central image small relative to the canvas?
Are the fonts centered and stacked?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the two font styles?

postGenerationChecks: Check for perfect vertical alignment of all elements.
Ensure the photograph does not exceed 30% of the total area.
Verify the background is not pure #FFFFFF white.
Confirm the decorative font has internal details or high-contrast stems.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cream Background + Small Centered Framed Photo + Stacked High-Contrast Serif Typography
